title: Returns and refunds
body: Unworn items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 working days of the return being received. Orders that have not shipped can be cancelled for a full refund.

title: Delivery times
body: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 working days. Express delivery orders placed before 2pm arrive the next working day. Tracking links are emailed when the parcel leaves the warehouse.

title: Damaged or faulty items
body: If an item arrives damaged, send a photo within 14 days. We refund or replace faulty items; the customer does not pay return postage.

title: Changing your account details
body: Customers can change their email address, password and preferred language from the account page. Support staff cannot change a password for a customer.

title: Gift cards
body: Gift cards are valid for 24 months and cannot be exchanged for cash or refunded.
